module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There is + a/an + adjective + noun
en: There is a beautiful garden behind the house.
tr: Evin arkasında güzel bir bahçe var.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈbjutəfəl ˈgɑrdən bɪˈhaɪnd ðə haʊs/
trPron: Der iz ı byutıfıl gardın bihaynd dı haus
collocations: there is a, beautiful garden
commonMistake: Is a beautiful garden. ❌
aiExplain: Sıfat olsa bile "There is" yapısı değişmez.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There are + adjective + plural noun
en: There are fresh apples on the tree.
ipa: /ðɛr ɑr frɛʃ ˈæpəlz ɑn ðə tri/
trPron: Der ar freş epıls on dı tri
collocations: there are fresh, on the tree
commonMistake: There is fresh apples. ❌
aiExplain: Çoğul isimler "There are" ile kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There isn't any + singular noun
en: There isn't any milk in the fridge.
ipa: /ðɛr ˈɪzənt ˈɛni mɪlk ɪn ðə frɪʤ/
trPron: Der izınt eni milk in dı fric
collocations: isn't any milk, any milk
commonMistake: There isn't no any milk. ❌
aiExplain: Negatif cümlede "any" doğru, "no any" yanlıştır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There aren't any + plural noun
en: There aren't any eggs left.
ipa: /ðɛr ɑrnt ˈɛni ɛgz lɛft/
trPron: Der arnt eni egz left
collocations: aren't any eggs, any eggs
commonMistake: There isn't any eggs left. ❌
aiExplain: Eggs çoğul olduğu için "aren't any" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: How many + plural noun + are there?
en: How many students are there in your class?
ipa: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈstudənts ɑr ðɛr ɪn jʊr klæs/
trPron: Hav meni studınts ar der in yur klas
collocations: how many students, are there
commonMistake: How many students there are in your class? ❌
aiExplain: How many students there are yanlış sıralamadır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: How much + uncountable noun + is there?
en: How much sugar is there in this recipe?
tr: Bu tarifte ne kadar şeker var?
ipa: /haʊ mʌʧ ˈʃʊgər ɪz ðɛr ɪn ðɪs ˈrɛsəpi/
trPron: Hav maç şugır iz der in dis resıpi
collocations: how much sugar, is there
commonMistake: How many sugar is there? ❌
aiExplain: Sugar sayılamayan olduğu için "how much" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There is + some + uncountable noun
en: There is some bread on the counter.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz sʌm brɛd ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntər/
trPron: Der iz sam bred on dı kauntır
collocations: there is some, some bread
commonMistake: There is any bread. ❌ (soru/negatif için any)
aiExplain: Olumlu cümlede "some" kullanılır, "any" değil.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There are + some + plural noun
en: There are some good movies on Netflix.
ipa: /ðɛr ɑr sʌm gʊd ˈmuviz ɑn nɛtˈflɪks/
trPron: Der ar sam gud muviz on Netflix
collocations: there are some, some good
commonMistake: There are any good movies. ❌
aiExplain: Olumlu çoğul cümlede "some" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
topic: There is with a pair of
scenario: There is + a pair of + plural noun
en: There is a pair of shoes under the bed.
tr: Yatağın altında bir çift ayakkabı var.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ə pɛr əv ʃuz ˈʌndər ðə bɛd/
trPron: Der iz ı per ov şuz andır dı bed
collocations: there is a pair, a pair of
commonMistake: There are a pair of shoes. ❌ (tartışmalı)
aiExplain: A pair of tekil kabul edilir, "There is" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
topic: There is with a number of
scenario: There is + a number of + plural noun (formal)
en: There is a number of reasons for his decision.
tr: Onun kararı için bir dizi neden var.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈnʌmbər əv ˈrizənz fɔr hɪz dɪˈsɪʒən/
trPron: Der iz ı nambır ov rizınz for hiz disijın
collocations: there is a number, a number of
commonMistake: There are a number of reasons. ✔️ (daha yaygın)
aiExplain: Resmi İngilizcede "A number of" tekil kabul edilebilir.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There is + something + somewhere
en: There is something in my eye.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪn maɪ aɪ/
trPron: Der iz samtİng in may ay
collocations: there is something, something in
commonMistake: There are something in my eye. ❌
aiExplain: Something tekil olduğu için "There is" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There is + nothing + location
en: There is nothing in the fridge.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪn ðə frɪʤ/
trPron: Der iz nating in dı fric
collocations: there is nothing, nothing in
commonMistake: There are nothing in the fridge. ❌
aiExplain: Nothing tekil kabul edilir.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There is + someone/no one + location
en: There is no one at the door.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz noʊ wʌn æt ðə dɔr/
trPron: Der iz no van at dı dor
collocations: there is no one, no one at
commonMistake: There are no one at the door. ❌
aiExplain: No one tekil olduğu için "There is" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There is + lots of + uncountable noun
en: There is lots of information online.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz lɑts əv ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən ˈɑnlaɪn/
trPron: Der iz lots ov infermeyşın online
collocations: there is lots of, lots of
commonMistake: There are lots of information. ❌
aiExplain: Information sayılamayan olduğu için "There is" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
topic: There is with a couple of
scenario: There is + a couple of + plural noun (singular verb)
en: There is a couple of things I need to tell you.
tr: Sana söylemem gereken birkaç şey var.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈkʌpəl əv θɪŋz aɪ nid tu tɛl ju/
trPron: Der iz ı kapıl ov tİngz ay nid tu tel yu
collocations: there is a couple, a couple of
commonMistake: There are a couple of things. ✔️ (daha yaygın)
aiExplain: A couple of bazen tekil fiil alabilir.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There is + a little + uncountable noun
en: There is a little time left.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈlɪtəl taɪm lɛft/
trPron: Der iz ı litıl taym left
collocations: there is a little, a little time
commonMistake: There are a few time left. ❌
aiExplain: A little sayılamayan isimlerle (time) kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There are + a few + plural noun
en: There are a few apples left in the basket.
ipa: /ðɛr ɑr ə fjuː ˈæpəlz lɛft ɪn ðə ˈbæskɪt/
trPron: Der ar ı fyu epıls left in dı basket
collocations: there are a few, a few apples
commonMistake: There is a little apples left. ❌
aiExplain: A few sayılabilir çoğul isimlerle kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: What + is there + location?
en: What is there to eat in the fridge?
ipa: /wʌt ɪz ðɛr tu it ɪn ðə frɪʤ/
trPron: Vat iz der tu it in dı fric
collocations: what is there, to eat in
commonMistake: What there is to eat? ❌
aiExplain: What there is yanlış sıralamadır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
topic: There is with no + noun + left
scenario: There is + no + noun + left (time)
en: There is no time left for questions.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz noʊ taɪm lɛft fɔr ˈkwɛsʧənz/
trPron: Der iz no taym left for kuesçınz
collocations: there is no time, no time
commonMistake: There are no time left. ❌
aiExplain: Time sayılamayan olduğu için "There is" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There is + someone + verb-ing + location
grammar: Birisi bir yerde bir şey yapıyor
en: There is someone waiting for you outside.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ˈsʌmwʌn ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr ju ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
trPron: Der iz samvan veytİng for yu autsayd
collocations: there is someone, waiting for you
commonMistake: There are someone waiting. ❌
aiExplain: Someone tekil olduğu için "There is" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
topic: There is with nothing + to do
scenario: There is + nothing + to do + location
en: There is nothing to do in this town.
tr: Bu kasabada yapacak hiçbir şey yok.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ˈnʌθɪŋ tu du ɪn ðɪs taʊn/
trPron: Der iz nating tu du in dis taun
collocations: there is nothing, nothing to do
commonMistake: There are nothing to do. ❌
aiExplain: Nothing tekil olduğu için "There is" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There is + a whole + singular noun
en: There is a whole day ahead of us.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ə hoʊl deɪ əˈhɛd əv ʌs/
trPron: Der iz ı hol dey ahead ov as
collocations: there is a whole, a whole day
commonMistake: There are a whole day. ❌
aiExplain: Day tekil olduğu için "There is" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
topic: There is with an amount of
scenario: There is + an amount of + uncountable noun
en: There is a large amount of money in the safe.
tr: Kasada büyük bir miktar para var.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ə lɑrʤ əˈmaʊnt əv ˈmʌni ɪn ðə seɪf/
trPron: Der iz ı larc amaynt ov mani in dı seyf
collocations: there is a large, amount of money
commonMistake: There are a large amount of money. ❌
aiExplain: Money sayılamayan olduğu için "There is" kullanılır.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
topic: There is with a total of
scenario: There is + a total of + number + plural noun
en: There is a total of fifty students in the school.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈtoʊtəl əv ˈfɪfti ˈstudənts ɪn ðə skul/
trPron: Der iz ı totıl ov fifti studınts in dı skul
collocations: there is a total, total of
commonMistake: There are a total of fifty students. ✔️ (daha yaygın)
aiExplain: A total of resmi dilde tekil fiil alabilir.

module: A1-M08 There Is / There Are · P2
scenario: There is + more than + number + plural noun
en: There is more than one way to solve this problem.
tr: Bu sorunu çözmenin birden fazla yolu var.
ipa: /ðɛr ɪz mɔr ðæn wʌn weɪ tu sɑlv ðɪs ˈprɑbləm/
trPron: Der iz mor den van vey tu salv dıs prablım
collocations: there is more than, more than one
commonMistake: There are more than one way. ❌
aiExplain: More than one tekil kabul edilir.
